✨ Grammar Guide · Expressing the future

Before Exercises 3–4, learn how to talk about what somebody will do.

✅

WILL + verb

She will do the cooking.

Future action

❌

WON’T + verb

She won’t wash the car.

Will not = won’t

❓

WILL + person + verb?

Will she feed the dog?

Yes, she will. / No, she won’t.

Remember: will / won’t + base verb (not will does or will to do).
Will + verb exprimă o acțiune viitoare: She will cook — Ea va găti. Won’t înseamnă „nu va”: She won’t cook — Ea nu va găti. La întrebare, will se pune la început: Will she cook? — Va găti ea? După will folosim verbul la forma de bază.
Will + глагол обозначает действие в будущем: She will cook — Она будет готовить. Won’t означает «не будет»: She won’t cook — Она не будет готовить. В вопросе will ставится перед подлежащим: Will she cook? — Она будет готовить? После will глагол употребляется в начальной форме.

🗣️ Pronunciation Guide · ch /tʃ/ and sh /ʃ/

Listen, repeat and notice the difference between the two sounds.

ch → /tʃ/

chores · kitchen · child · children · chocolate

sh → /ʃ/

shopping · rubbish · wash · dish · dishwasher

💬 Exercise 8 · Make up questions and answer them

Use the word pairs to make questions and answers. No extra pictures are needed.

Textbook model: cooker / bedroom
A: Is there a cooker in the bedroom?
B: No, there isn’t. There is a cooker in the kitchen.
1. plate / chair
Write a question and answer.
Show a model after tryingIs there a plate on the chair? — No, there isn’t / aren’t. (Your answer may vary depending on the situation.)
2. sink / living room
Write a question and answer.
Show a model after tryingIs there a sink in the living room? — No, there isn’t / aren’t. (Your answer may vary depending on the situation.)
3. washing machine / bedroom
Write a question and answer.
Show a model after tryingIs there a washing machine in the bedroom? — No, there isn’t / aren’t. (Your answer may vary depending on the situation.)
4. dishes / dishwasher
Write a question and answer.
Show a model after tryingAre there dishes in the dishwasher? — No, there isn’t / aren’t. (Your answer may vary depending on the situation.)
5. cups / bookcase
Write a question and answer.
Show a model after tryingAre there cups in the bookcase? — No, there isn’t / aren’t. (Your answer may vary depending on the situation.)
